Messages.Author: Torbjörn Gräslund
Messages.Body:
This came up during last weeks gaming session.

Minion A attempts to bleed.
No blocking attempts are made.
Can minion A play Fata Morgana to get +1 bleed even though he doesn't
need the stealth?

-TG

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. You cannot add stealth when you don't need stealth.
